original_test_intent: Verify the Type 9 Segment Group Number component of each slot's optional PCI bus address maps the slot to the approved PCI segment/domain, uses the defined unknown/not-applicable sentinel only where allowed, and persists after reboot.
original_method: Validate the Type 9 formatted length, extract raw segment, bus and device/function components as one atomic address tuple, bind it to the slot identity, compare with the approved firmware/OS PCI-domain map, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the Type 9-to-PCI domain map, sentinel handling and reboot plan. No PCI rebinding or topology change is required.
required_inputs: Expected PCI segment/domain per exact Type 9 slot
Applicable SMBIOS version and Type 9 formatted length
Policy for the defined unknown/not-applicable address tuple and unpopulated slots
Expected segment:bus:device.function tuple or mapping rule
Validated raw parser, read-only PCI inventory and approved reboot/OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS and PCI enumeration only; do not change domain assignment, device binding, firmware or card population.
Validate record length before reading the bus-address extension and preserve the entire tuple; a segment value alone is not a BDF.
Interpret the specification-defined sentinel as a complete tuple condition and do not normalize it to segment zero.
Account for OS domain formatting and platform topology without assuming every unpopulated slot has an enumerable endpoint.
Stop on malformed/partial tuples, mapping drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Extract raw Type 9 address fields, determine present versus sentinel state, correlate the complete tuple with read-only PCI domain evidence and compare before/after reboot.
Do not alter PCI state or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the slot-to-domain map and sentinel/unpopulated policy.
Approve reboot/recovery, resolve firmware-versus-OS topology exceptions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `Segment Group Num` grep may return nothing because common dmidecode output renders the extension as a combined `Bus Address`; even if present, the segment fragment cannot validate tuple consistency.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 9 records, validate structure length and report segment:bus:device.function atomically with raw bytes, slot identity and read-only OS PCI-domain correlation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Segment Group Num scope, Type 9 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; the original grep is preserved but not treated as complete evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the optional address extension from raw Type 9 data, distinguish the complete sentinel from a real domain, render canonical domain:bus:device.function and correlate it to the approved topology and read-only OS inventory.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 9 records whose formatted length includes the PCI address extension.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, Type 9 length, OS and parser/PCI-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 9 Segment Group Number and bus/device/function layout, approved PCI topology map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Uses length-gated raw tuple parsing instead of a likely absent isolated label and prevents sentinel-to-zero normalization.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; adds tuple integrity and actual domain correlation while retaining unpopulated/sentinel semantics.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Exact slot-to-domain/tuple map and sentinel policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS PCI inventory may not enumerate an empty slot, so firmware topology evidence remains authoritative under the approved policy.

project_override_considerations: A project may accept the specified unknown/not-applicable tuple for an unmapped or non-PCI slot, but must not accept an arbitrary segment component when the other address bytes form a partial tuple.
expected_evidence: Approved topology, per-slot PCI domain/tuple expectations, SMBIOS version and sentinel policy
Complete pre-reboot Type 9 records with structure length, slot identity, raw address bytes and canonical tuple
Read-only OS PCI domain/BDF inventory and per-slot correlation or documented unpopulated/sentinel result
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot tuple/map diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source names a canonical Type 9 address component; complete tuple parsing resolves the abbreviated label without changing intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The segment and tuple are safely parseable/correlatable once a project map is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Corrects an unreliable isolated grep and adds record-length, sentinel and tuple-integrity handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains PCI-domain correlation and safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates missing topology/package/reboot inputs from capability and formal verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents treating the absent/unknown sentinel as PCI domain 0000 and prevents a valid segment number from masking inconsistent bus/device/function bytes.
independent_technical_reasoning: The segment is a fixed component of an optional Type 9 address tuple; length-aware raw parsing and read-only topology correlation are deterministic software operations.
